mapper.select: SELECT ci.id AS item_id, ci.category, ci.item_text, ci.severity, cr.status, cr.evidence_text, cr.evidence_attachment_uuid, cr.checked_by, cr.checked_at FROM safety_guideline_report r JOIN safety_checklist_item ci ON ci.template_id = r.template_id AND ci.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN safety_check_result cr ON cr.report_id = r.id AND cr.item_id = ci.id WHERE r.id = #{reportId} ORDER BY ci.sort_order, ci.id
SELECT * FROM safety_check_result WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO safety_check_result (report_id, item_id, checked_by, status, evidence_text, evidence_attachment_uuid) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{itemId}, #{checkedBy}, #{status}, #{evidenceText}, #{evidenceAttachmentUuid}) ON CONFLICT (report_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET checked_by = EXCLUDED.checked_by, status = EXCLUDED.status, evidence_text = EXCLUDED.evidence_text, evidence_attachment_uuid = EXCLUDED.evidence_attachment_uuid, checked_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_check_result WHERE status = 'DONE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_check_result WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_check_result WHERE status = 'BLOCKED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_check_result WHERE status = 'NA'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_checklist_item WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
